name: Advanced Mutagen
body:
Your mutagenic form can enhance your muscles rather than your mental abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Advanced cognatogen class feature, mutagen discovery.

Benefit(s): You gain the master chymist’s advanced mutagen class feature and can select advanced mutagens normally even if you have the alchemical genius archetype.
